alerts.hint: Each active milestone alerts at the exact contact. Chips add an early warning {sec} s before; C1 also 1 h and 24 h ahead.
alerts.desc.C1: Glasses on to look at the sun.
alerts.desc.C2: In the path: get ready to look without glasses.
alerts.desc.C3: GLASSES BACK ON. The sun is dangerous again.
alerts.belowHorizon: After sunset — the sun will no longer be visible here
notif.C1.early.title: ☀️ The eclipse starts in a few seconds
notif.C1.title: ☀️ The eclipse begins
notif.C1.body: ECLIPSE GLASSES ON to look at the sun.
notif.C2.early.title: 🌑 Totality in a few seconds
notif.C2.early.body: Heads-up: very soon you can look without glasses.
notif.C2.title: 🌑 Totality
notif.C2.body: You can look without glasses now. Enjoy.
notif.MAX.early.title: 🌗 Maximum in a few seconds
notif.MAX.early.body: Heads-up for the peak of the eclipse.
notif.MAX.title: 🌗 Maximum
notif.C3.early.title: ⚠️ Totality ends in a few seconds
notif.C3.title: ⚠️ TOTALITY ENDS

notif.C4.early.title: Eclipse ends in a few seconds

notif.plan24h.title: Eclipse tomorrow

notif.plan1h.title: Eclipse in 1 hour

notif.test.title: 🔔 Eclipsum test

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Pick your observation spot on the map by tapping the place name at the top left.
map.safety.title: Never look at the sun without certified glasses
map.safety.body: Only during totality is it safe to look without protection. The app will alert you at the exact start and end.
map.safety.affiliate: Affiliate link: supports the app at no extra cost to you.
settings.drill.startHint: Eclipse mode with C1 in 1 min and the full run in 2 min, with [DRILL] alerts based on yours. Real ones are untouched.
settings.upcoming.note: By default the nearest one is followed{manual}. Each eclipse keeps its own spot and alerts; scheduled notifications are for the active one.
settings.support.body: Eclipsum is free, ad-free and open source. If it's useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
settings.aboutNote: Eclipse times are computed on your phone and work offline. Only the cloud forecast and the place search need internet.
